authorization: User requests every GG widget reproduced for DG, published at gg&dg on GitHub. Explicit reply: План ДГ пока не задан. Existing GG metric definitions are inherited, never GG targets. Follow-up: remove requested plan, dynamics, manager, production, data-discipline and offer-control widgets; swap speed/loss widgets before deal funnel; add deal/sales switch, zero rings and lead/deal reason tables.

population.leads: Candidate set is exact SOURCE_ID UC_NQ3QUI leads plus the explicitly referenced parent leads of direct source-DG category49 deals. Every candidate must still have an actual bound incoming From mailbox domain exactly domglass.ru. No contact/company expansion. Original CRM lead source is preserved. Non-DG-source leads require private admitted direct-deal and sender proofs checked again by the builder.
population.deals: Direct DG source or link to a qualifying lead; any deal linked to an explicitly sender-rejected candidate lead is excluded.
population.enrichment: Stage history, direct lead/deal activities and linked production items only. Shared contact/company communication cannot be attributed to DG and is excluded.

reference.runtimeVersion: Manifest SHA-256 of actual template used by Pages

period: Inclusive Moscow dates. Lead cohort by creation. GG default 30 days, weekly buckets. User can select dates, month, granularity, creation/outcome date basis and created/active funnel modes. Current day partial. Open-pipeline and discipline widgets operate on the current open inventory where the GG reference does so.
conversion: GG CR1 = converted leads / same lead creation cohort. CR2 and success rates use GG selected cohort/outcome basis and displayed denominators. Ratios are descriptive CRM metrics, not controlled acquisition attribution or fixed-maturation conversion.
money: GG prepayment/won mode and budget/prepayment amount switches are preserved. Default prepayment event uses first EXECUTING stage, then first later stage in history, then close-date fallback for a won record; amount uses selected CRM field. Open pipeline = current opportunity, not bank revenue. No refunds/tax/accounting inference. RUB/category 49 contract checked before publication.
plan: All plan UI and sales-health widgets removed; no GG targets imported.
production: GG transfer event and SP1086 link/quantity fields, restricted to eligible deal IDs. Zero linked items is known empty, not unavailable. No sales/production assumed when missing.
manager: Current assigned managers from DG data, including inactive owners. System/non-sales accounts stay in totals/unallocated rows. Manager cards filter the same DG page; no link to all-source personal dashboards.
privacy: Customer titles/photos and credentials excluded. Directly bound DG communication text/subjects and reason notes included by user request. Contact masking retained, all URLs and credential-like markers redacted; IDs plain text. Per-record JSON authenticated and scoped; no raw snapshot or credentials in Git.
freshness: Independent VPS refresh every 15 minutes. Private raw snapshot; atomic publication retains last successful release on failure. Input older than 24 hours fails validation. Source and build timestamps remain visible.
limitations: Live CRM and GG snapshot share a source family. No external financial reconciliation. Unsupported future currency/category fails publication explicitly; parent source changes must satisfy adapter contracts. No DG sales plan exists.

distribution.default: Deals, count; FD creation cohort with current global filters, every status.
distribution.sales: Original GG soldSet: selected prepayment/won mode and creation/outcome dates.
distribution.money: Deals use opportunity; sales use selected opportunity/prepayment amount. Missing opportunity is counted separately. RUB only.
distribution.invariants: All categories retained; sum of category counts equals selected records, sum of monetary categories equals selected known amounts. Zero totals show gray rings, never fake segments.
distribution.interaction: All three distribution diagrams and their legends are static. No segment or category click opens a table; Deals/Sales and Count/Amount controls remain. Detailed records stay in the calendar.

drilldown.leads: Lead funnel and refusal chart are static, with no click handlers or standalone table below the funnel. Lead details remain in the calendar by responsible and record. Distribution diagrams are static too.
drilldown.deals: Distribution diagrams never open a table. Detailed owner/date/stage/reason/budget/prepayment and communication information is available only through calendar levels. Record IDs stay plain text.
drilldown.privacy: Only exact known operational labels are published from lead string fields. Other text becomes Другая причина (см. CRM); missing = Не заполнена. Deal free text stays in CRM.
drilldown.reasonDenominator: Refused leads in selected status/funnel subset, before optional reason/search filtering. Number and share are displayed explicitly.

layout.order: Lead funnel and reasons, then deal funnel. Main cross-conversion is vertical with unchanged lead/qualified/sales values.
layout.header: No refresh-status badge, section navigation or migration-period button. Freshness timestamp, filters and ordinary period/date controls stay.
layout.filters: Four distributed full-width sections: date basis, revenue recognition, amount field and granularity. Direction removed; initial direction scope resets to all eligible DG records. Footer help link/animation/scroll/focus unchanged.

calendar.population: All current source-eligible DG leads/deals, irrespective of their creation date when counting later stage events.
calendar.dates: Inclusive Europe/Moscow dates; current day partial.
calendar.leadLost: First historical F semantic entry; reason/current assignee from current CRM card.

wip.formula: Latest history event at min(bucket end 23:59:59.999+03:00,snapshot time) is this stage with P semantics. Period total is final stock, not sum of buckets.

stages.lost: First F semantic deal history event

calendar.eventPolicy: First lifetime entry only; repeat entries do not inflate counts. History completeness/current-stage consistency required before publication. Different stage rows are not additive.
calendar.money: Lead: known RUB opportunity, missing/foreign currency flagged. Deal: selected amount field. Manager table budget labelled separately.
calendar.manager: Current responsible manager, not historical owner.
calendar.presentation: Initially five top-level calendar rows: leads, lead refusals, deals, success and deal refusal. Deals expand to indented forming-TZ, KP, prepayment, production and shipping stages; then responsible, record and communications. Right mini-charts use exactly the same bucket values, filters, count/money and budget/prepayment basis as each displayed heat row, including responsible rows. Stock remains stock, never a summed flow.
calendar.refusalColumn: Separate current CRM refusal reason column for refused leads and deals. Lead detail uses observed reason fields; deal reason uses the existing reason-comment field, then enum fallback. Decode, redact and contact-mask before publication; escape when rendered.
calendar.navigation: One GG-style heat-calendar matrix: all existing stages are rows in the left column, dates across the same rows, totals on the right. No side navigation or tabs. Stage label expands responsible rows inline; record and communication tables need separate clicks. Each nested table scrolls independently and is indented.
calendar.amount: Independent calendar amount field: budget by default, with an explicit budget/prepayment switch in money mode. Deals use existing budget or prepayAmt; leads keep their own CRM opportunity. Existing RUB/missing-value rules and all row/date/stock cohorts are unchanged. Global default prepayment remains unchanged.
calendar.detailPlacement: Selected manager detail is inserted immediately after that manager heat row and before the next manager, without repeated stage heading or manager summary. Stage-cell totals appear under the stage row; record history remains directly after its record. Existing stage/responsible/record scopes, date buckets and amount choices are unchanged.
calendar.sparkHover: Each transparent point hit region uses the existing native dashboard tooltip: actual clipped bucket date range, stage/responsible label, record count, and selected amount in money mode. Values and count come from the exact heat-cell series; no interpolation or invented samples. Calendar rows use tighter spacing.
calendar.sparkMissingMoney: Tooltip explicitly distinguishes unknown/partial sums from genuine known zero and counts records missing an amount.

comparison: Previous adjacent interval has the same inclusive number of days as selected period. If previous metric is zero/absent, neutral 0% placeholder with tooltip. Otherwise (current-previous)/abs(previous).
access: Dedicated DG Basic Auth on TLS /gg-dg/ only. No common API, no legacy fallback. Code and raw data live outside shared www/current. Both former GitHub Pages routes are removed (404), without redirects.
planPresentation: All plan controls, notices and calendar plan strips are removed. Sales health is removed. Factual metric definitions are unchanged.

communications.authorization: User asks all communications for DG leads/deals with Dialog table hierarchy.
sources: Complete Bitrix activity lists filtered by exact BINDINGS
Existing read-only loopback Dialog cache, only eligible L/D keys
communications.dedup: Global source ID act#/cmt#; union of direct eligible bindings. Converted lead cache events can live under D-key but original entity stage is rechecked. Deal history includes originating eligible lead; aggregate counts use distinct event IDs.
communications.types: Calls/email/messages/SMS count as communications; tasks/notes/service/stages are separate events.
communications.period: Full record history on expansion. Communication rows use a neutral background, without period or hover fills; calendar filters and calculations are unchanged.
communications.delivery: Unique sanitized events are embedded in the authenticated HTML snapshot and mapped by the existing per-record ID index. Counters and event history always share a generation. Dedicated-auth per-record JSON files remain for compatibility; no arbitrary proxy.
communications.security: Contact mask, escaped text, no links/webhooks/keys/AI actions; existing transcripts only, no model or Telegram API use.
communications.coverage: Source API visibility applies. Dialog freshness is explicit and can lag. Missing cache is a labelled gap, not zero communication. No claim of recovering deleted/unavailable CRM content.
communications.presentation: No full-history heading or channel toolbar. Sort remains. HTML character references decoded as plain text before URL redaction and escaping; no HTML interpretation in browser.
communications.emailText: Remove raw style/script elements before native HTML-to-text conversion. Archived text removes only whole standalone Outlook VML behavior rules for v/o/w namespaces or .shape. Preserve ordinary message prose and existing escaping, masks and redaction.
communications.technicalPresentation: Non-communication events use muted text and purple channel badges; real calls/email/messages/SMS retain their existing text styling. All row backgrounds remain neutral; classification does not alter counts or filtering.

mailCohort.authorization: 26.10.2026 user: вот от домглас оставляем только; 27.10.2026 explicit user choice: include confirmed parent leads linked to DG deals even when their own CRM source is Other. CRM records stay unchanged.
mailCohort.evidence: EMAIL_META.from of incoming TYPE_ID4/DIRECTION1 activities. Positive email bindings explicitly checked. No incoming evidence excludes the lead; missing API metadata/failure aborts publication rather than producing zero.
mailCohort.linkedParentPolicy: Fetch missing parents only by exact IDs present in direct DG category49 deal LEAD_ID. Require complete/unique scoped responses and the same incoming sender validation as ordinary DG leads. Builder proves admitted source-DG deal -> exact parent ID -> confirmed incoming sender; unverifiable or foreign candidates never enter the snapshot.
mailCohort.authorizedReconciliation: Expected for the reviewed current records:12leads =7converted +4refused +1open;7relateddeals. This is a verification case, not a fixed production count or a universal one-deal-per-lead invariant.

refusals.authorization: 27.10.2026 user requests lead/deal refusal fields, left horizontal reason chart with top10/30/50, right collapsible table with20 rows per page and no horizontal scrolling.
refusals.population: Exactly the union of calendar leadLost and lost rows under current period and global filters. Calendar first-failure history semantics are retained, including an event whose current record may later have reopened. Lead and deal are distinct records, never deduplicated into customers.
refusals.reason: Detailed sanitized lead reason when available, otherwise record reason or missing marker. Group labels normalize whitespace/case only; no invented categories. Top N limits bars only, never table population.
refusals.fields: Separate columns for typed record ID, responsible, creation date, first-refusal date, latest indexed event date MSK, stage, reason, client type, assortment, originating lead. Desktop is single-line with complete cell text in title; no data removal. All record IDs and originating-lead labels are typed plain text without links or navigation.
refusals.pagination: Superseded by user27.10: full-width compact table below the reason chart, maximum10 visible desktop data rows (30px each plus60px sticky header); every filtered record remains reachable by internal vertical scroll. No20-row pagination. Per-column multi-select/date-range filters and ascending/descending sort apply to the same source population as the chart. Narrow layouts retain column controls and stacked records.
refusals.timezone: Europe/Moscow for first failure, activity and communication dates, including events across UTC midnight.
refusals.duplicate: Scoped read of the user-selected duplicate confirmed no original-lead reference field or URL. Never infer/hardcode a target ID. Show missing original ID explicitly; no CRM modification or CRM link.
refusals.filters: Column headers retain sorting. Non-date filters open searchable faceted multi-select lists, with apply/reset and counts ignoring their own current filter. Date columns use an independent two-month calendar with exact-day double click, inclusive from/to range and highlighted selection/hover preview. Only the refusal table/reason chart are filtered, never the global dashboard dates.

kpiCharts.population: Reuse native flt/mtr/soldSet/lostSet for every clipped interval under the current manager/source/client/direction/date-basis/revenue/amount filters. Card formulas remain unchanged.
kpiCharts.comparison: Previous dates are each current interval shifted back by periodLen days: equal-length disjoint aligned windows, with both exact date ranges in tooltips. Each metric is independently aggregated, never an average of ratios.
kpiCharts.nulls: CR1 with no leads, CR2 with no deals, and check with no sales are unobserved/null points with gaps and No base text, not fake zero. Count/amount known zeros remain zeros. Current future-only buckets have null metrics.
kpiCharts.stock: Historical open-set membership uses latest typed stage semantic P at bucket end (MSK). Planned DATE_CLOSED on currently open records never closes a historical stock. Fallback only with no history uses creation and actual terminal flag/close date. Money uses current budgets, explicitly labelled estimate; current endpoint uses current open flags. No claim of historical budget revisions.
kpiCharts.interaction: Solid current and dashed previous on common scale. Native tooltip plus CSS hover vertical dashed guide and points for each observed trace. Calendar uses same point/guide and removes crosshair cursor. No network/model calls.
kpiCharts.tooltipPresentation: Separate visually bounded current/previous blocks, each with explicit date-range label and explicit quantity/conversion/money label. Open-budget points use a snapshot end date rather than an interval sum, with explicit distinction from current card total. Numbers/formulas/date alignment unchanged. Observed stock dates are capped at DATA.to; future-only buckets retain no observations. Historical dates and numeric series remain unchanged.
kpiCharts.axis: Always-visible zero baseline in every KPI/calendar mini line chart; KPI current start/end date labels below. Shared scale and hover points/vertical dashed guides retained.

communicationPresentation.entity: Separate typed entity column from actual event bindings; a shared lead/deal event remains one event in the complete chain. Per-record entity filter never changes the source snapshot.
communicationPresentation.order: Exact source timestamp ascending by default, including visible seconds in MSK. Only equal timestamps use lead-stage, deal-stage, then other-event tie order, with stable ID fallback. Reverse mode reverses the full ordering.
communicationPresentation.text: Display-only whitespace compression: CRLF to LF, repeated horizontal whitespace to one space, at most one blank paragraph line. No truncation or source mutation.
communicationPresentation.viewport: Independent reader up to 520px / 65vh desktop, 420px / 65vh mobile. Outer table scroll caps expand only while a reader is open.
communicationPresentation.fullReader: Long messages offer a top-positioned Read in full action. Native modal dialog shows the complete escaped message/transcript in one independently scrolling region, with MSK time and typed bindings; close/Escape restores focus. No fetch or new source data.
